senses.gloss: f. (b. h.; = נאוה, v. אוּת) suited, becoming; handsome. Tanḥ.
units: <cite ref="Exodus 11">B’shall. 11</cite> <he>נ׳ שירה וכ׳</he> it is meet to sing unto the Lord.

<cite ref="Shabbat 133b:5">Sabb. 133ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Nazir 2b:8">Naz. 2ᵇ</cite> <he>סוכה נ׳</he> a handsome Succah; a. fr.—Ib. I, 1, v. <cite ref="N00317"><he>נָוֶה</he></cite>.—Pl. <cite ref="N00019"><he>נָאִים</he></cite>, <he>נָאִין</he>; <cite ref="N00016"><he>נָאוֹת</he></cite>. Sifra Aḥăré, end (ref. to <cite ref="Leviticus 18:26">Lev. XVIII, 26</cite> <he>ושמרתם אתם</he>) <he>אתם נ׳ שומרים וכ׳</he> you are the proper persons to guard them (the laws of chastity), because you opened (were the first to observe) them. Tanḥ. Masʿé 4 <he>הם נ׳ ולבושיהם נ׳ הם נ׳ לארץ וכ׳</he> they are handsome, and their garments are becoming, they are suited to the land, and the land to them.
<cite ref="Mishnah Nedarim 9:10">Ned. IX, 10</cite> <he>בנות ישראל נ׳ הן אלא וכ׳</he> the daughters of Israel are good-looking, but misery disfigures them. Sabb. l. c.

<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 320:1">Sifré Deut. 320</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Deuteronomy 32:19">Deut. XXXII, 19</cite>) <he>ממה שהם נ׳ לו וכ׳</he> because they are pleasing to him (he calling them sons and daughters), they are bold before him.
Tosef. Sot. II, 3 יולדת נ׳ she will bear handsome children; Y. ib. III, 18ᵈ bot. נָעִים; a. fr.—נָאוֹת f. pl. (noun) beauties.
<cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">Lam. R. to II, 2</cite> (ref. to <he>נאות</he>, <cite ref="Eichah Rabbah 2:4">ib.</cite>) <he>כל נְאוֹתָיו של יצקב</he> all the beauties (excellent men) of Jacob.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 244:6">Yalk. Ex. 244</cite> (ref. to <he>ואנוהו</he>, <cite ref="Exodus 15:2">Ex. XV, 2</cite>) <he>אגיד נאותיו ושבחו של וכ׳</he> I will tell the excellencies and praises of &c.; <cite ref="Exodus 15:2">ib.</cite> <he>אדבר בנאותיו ושבחיו</he>; Mekh. B’shall., Shir., s. 3 <he>בנבואתו שבחו</he> (corr. acc.); <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 988:64">Yalk. Cant. 988</cite> <he>בנויתיו ובשבחו</he>, read: <he>בנוֹיוֹתָיו</he>, v. <cite ref="N00354"><he>נוֹי</he></cite>.
Treat. Sof’rim III, 13 היבות בנאות שלו speak much of his excellencies. Lam. R. introd. end, v. קִינָה; a. fr.—נָאֶה (adv.) becomingly, well.
<cite ref="Tosefta Yevamot 8:4">Tosef. Yeb. VIII, 4</cite>, a. e. <he>נ׳ דירש</he> preaches well, <he>ונ׳ מקיים</he> and acts in conformity (with his words).
